meta.name: The Rainmaker
meta.description: Fresh out of law school, Rudy Baylor goes head to head with courtroom lion Leo Drummond as well as his law school girlfriend, Sarah. Rudy, along with his boss, Bruiser, and her disheveled paralegal, Deck, uncovers two connected conspiracies surrounding the mysterious death of their client's son.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Fresh out of law school, Rudy Baylor confronts Leo F. Drummond in a medical malpractice case.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Rudy and Deck have a tense encounter with a witness and make a crucial discovery about their client.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As Rudy and Deck search for a missing nurse, their investigation suggests a dark conspiracy at play.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: When Sarah reveals a detail about the case, Rudy must choose between his client and his girlfriend.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Worried about Melvin's threat, Rudy defies Bruiser and risks his job and future as Dot's attorney.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Rudy continues to defend his client. Sarah faces new temptations in London with Leo and Brad.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: When Rudy gets arrested for murder, Bruiser agrees to represent him.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Rudy and Deck tail Melvin Pritcher, igniting a thrilling chain of events.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Rudy must decide whether to make an argument he can win or to expose the truth.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Up against Sarah, Rudy wonders if she's still the woman he once knew and loved.

videos.title: Dear Uncle Rudy
videos.overview: Rudy faces newfound attention as Deck fixates on a letter sent from juvenile detention.

videos.title: Cards Up
videos.overview: Rudy takes Victor's case to court while Bruiser and Sarah face troubles of their own.

videos.title: Chokepoint
videos.overview: Rudy and Deck search for evidence in their high-stakes case as Sarah meets an old colleague.

videos.title: Numerosity
videos.overview: A class action takes shape as Amanda tests Sarah's loyalty and Bruiser helps Tom's star pitcher.

videos.title: The Coral Sea
videos.overview: A charter boat, two men who don't fish, and a witness who won't testify—Victor lands in trouble at Medford, forcing Rudy to certify the class. Meanwhile, someone breaks into Bruiser's house.

videos.title: Morvatrivlet
videos.overview: Rudy and Deck chase a crucial link in their lawsuit but are distracted by Bruiser's disappearance.

videos.title: The High Court
videos.overview: Victor faces new trouble at Medford, pressuring Rudy to get the class certified.

videos.title: What You Know
videos.overview: Danger follows Sarah and Megan who approach unlikely allies. Mounting debts put pressure on Tom.

videos.title: What You Have
videos.overview: The trial begins as Rudy, Deck and Bruiser race to find evidence before an explosive stand-off.

videos.title: Who You Are
videos.overview: Young attorney Rudy Baylor is up against one of the most powerful law firms in the country.
